 assert r['source_extraction_status']=='ORIGINAL_BODY_AND_TITLE_BOUND' and sha(ROOT/r['raw_path'])==r['sha256']
 month=r['stat_month'];texts={p['paragraph_index']:p['text'] for p in r['manufacturing_paragraphs']}

 for k in ['生产','新订单']:
  value=prior['current_month_fields'][k]
  assert any(f'{value:.1f}%' in t for t in compact.values()),(month,k,value)
 clock={'original_data_release_anchor':prior['published_at'],'actual_received_at':r['received_at'],
        'url_archive_date':r['url_archive_date'],'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
        'clock_provenance':'当前官方网页显示/成文日期及当前收件；未证明不可变首版'}
 if month=='2024-01':
  soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/r['raw_path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
  label=soup.find(string=lambda x:isinstance(x,str) and '成文日期' in x)
  date_text=label.parent.parent.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  assert '2024年01月31日' in date_text

                'strict_decision_time_admission':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_DATE_ONLY'})

  independent=[{'paragraph_index':10,'type':'CAPACITY_UTILIZATION_SURVEY_LOWER_BOUND',
   'stat_month':month,'population':'本页制造业调查中的大型企业；非CSI300成分总体',
   'survey_statement':'超过七成的大型企业产能利用率达到或超过80.0%',
   'reported_share_comparator':'>','reported_share_bound_pct':70.0,'exact_share_pct':None,
   'capacity_threshold_comparator':'>=','capacity_threshold_pct':80.0,'sample_count':None,
   'field_limits':'仅下界，未知精确比例/样本数/指数权重；为产能状态事实，不是采购行为直接原因。',
   'source_fact_accepted':True,'model_admitted':False}]
  reason='有不同问项的产能状态下界，但不是直接采购动机；缺精确比例及同定义跨月原行/严格时钟，不准入模型。'
  direct='UNKNOWN';direct_evidence=[];survey_qualitative=[]
 elif month=='2024-02':
  assert '由于春节假日因素影响' in compact[7] and not r['purchase_behavior_theme']
  clock.update({'official_date_label':'页面显示发布时间','official_date':'2024-03-01',
                'publication_time_intraday':'09:30','page_display_time':'2024/03/01 09:30',
                'strict_decision_time_admission':'HISTORICAL_FIRST_VINTAGE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED'})
  assert '2024/03/01 09:30' in r['publication_leaf_candidates']
  independent=[];direct='UNKNOWN';direct_evidence=[];survey_qualitative=[]
  reason='官方把制造业活跃度走弱与春节/返乡/传统淡季联系；被解释对象不是采购行为，未发现不同原因调查数值。春节/复工背景已在旧PMI解释使用，不能换名当新因子。'
 else:
  assert '在生产和市场需求回升的带动下' in compact[8] and '采购量指数为52.7%' in compact[8]
  assert '反映行业竞争加剧、市场需求不足的企业比重仍然较高' in compact[13]
  clock.update({'official_date_label':'页面显示发布时间','official_date':'2024-03-31',
                'publication_time_intraday':'09:30','page_display_time':'2024/03/31 09:30',
                'strict_decision_time_admission':'HISTORICAL_FIRST_VINTAGE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED'})
  assert '2024/03/31 09:30' in r['publication_leaf_candidates']
  independent=[];direct='MIXED_OFFICIAL_PRODUCTION_AND_DEMAND_EXPLANATION'
  direct_evidence=[{'paragraph_index':8,'source_statement_supported':True,
    'paraphrase':'官方将采购增加与生产和市场需求回升共同联系。',

   'statement_type':'QUALITATIVE_HIGH_SHARE','model_admitted':False,
   'rule':'不得把较高填为精确占比/固定阈值或采购动机因果系数。'}]
  reason='采购直接官方解释可补充历史叙述；调查困难比例只有较高的文字，没有精确数值/变化。不得转为新量化原因输入，也不重开E36。'
 decision={'stat_month':month,'status':'MANUALLY_QUALIFIED_WITHIN_FIXED_SOURCE_PREFIX',
  'source_url':r['url'],'raw_path':r['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':r['sha256'],
  'official_identity_titles':r['official_identity_titles'],'clock':clock,
  'original_data_release_values_match':True,'purchase_direct_cause':direct,
  'direct_purchase_explanation':direct_evidence,'independent_survey_facts':independent,
  'qualitative_survey_cues':survey_qualitative,'why':reason,
  'manufacturing_paragraphs_reviewed':[p['paragraph_index'] for p in r['manufacturing_paragraphs']],
  'future_returns_used':False,'model_input_admitted':False,'goal_achieved':False}
 decisions.append(decision)
 panel.append({'统计月':month,'采购直接解释':direct,'独立调查数值状态':'LOWER_BOUND_ONLY' if independent else 'NOT_REPORTED',
  '官方日期':clock['official_date'],'日内发布时间':clock['publication_time_intraday'],
  'URL目录日期':'、'.join(clock['url_archive_date']),'当前收件时间':clock['actual_received_at'],
  '精确原因比例':'UNKNOWN','模型字段准入':False,'首版认证':False,'判定理由':reason,'来源':r['url']})
save('全部三月来源信息_人工裁决.json',decisions)
pd.DataFrame(panel).to_csv(OUT/'全部三月原因原文与时钟资格.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')

assert receipt['raw_official_get_count']==3 and receipt['public_search_query_count']==2 and total==219621

 'raw_bytes':total,'authenticated_provider_requests':0,'http200_raw_objects':3,
 'direct_official_purchase_explanation':{'count':1,'stat_months':['2024-03'],'grade':'OFFICIAL_JOINT_EXPLANATION_NOT_CAUSAL_EFFECT'},

 'new_prediction_fields_admitted':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,

 'next_step_limit':'本路线终止；只在已先证明实质不同原始信息/用途的研究方向另立有限来源问题，不把这三月文字变成参数或模型搜索。',
 'artifacts':{'protocol':REL+'/protocol.json','source_receipts':REL+'/原官方解读收件.json',

report='\n'.join([
